row.body: The map's route ends at a chalk line. A keyring rests across the fold back toward the starting point; its tag has no place name.
row.title: The lap with no return mark

sidecar.gloss: A route stops before its return and a key has no destination.
sidecar.rival_reading: A field crew could mark a temporary route and leave its gate key there; a missing place name does not prove an evacuation failed.
